en-US.longDescription:
Comet is a Chromium-based browser that integrates advanced AI capabilities powered by Perplexity. Unlike traditional browsers, Comet combines web browsing with intelligent features that enhance productivity and information access.
Comet also includes standard browser features like bookmarks, page translation, and support for most Chrome extensions.
en-US.name: Comet

zh-CN.longDescription:
Comet 是一款基于 Chromium 的浏览器，集成了由 Perplexity 提供支持的先进人工智能功能。与传统浏览器不同，Comet 将网页浏览与智能功能相结合，提升了生产力和信息获取效率。
Comet 还包含书签、网页翻译等标准浏览器功能，并支持大多数 Chrome 扩展程序。
